exposure: Robson Classification groups of birthing women
cohort: The study analyzed data on cesarean sections performed in teaching hospitals participating in the Project for Improvement and Innovation in the Care and Teaching of Obstetrics and Neonatology (Apice ON) in Brazil.
finding: Brazilian teaching hospitals exhibited cesarean section rates ranging from 24.8% to 75.1%, which are significantly higher than WHO recommended values across most Robson groups, including those considered low risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates in Brazilian teaching hospitals significantly exceeded WHO recommendations across all Robson groups, indicating a high prevalence of this mode of birth.
cross-section timing: Data from the 2017 Live Births Information System, covering the year prior to project implementation.
